Name: Pepper in Stardew Valley - Black Poodle Mod
Author: Kamikaze_Hamster
AuthorLabel: Art by VladBacescu and Programming by 7x7x7x7 on Reddit
Description:
I posted in r/StardewValley hoping someone would be able to immortalize my wife's dog in Stardew Valley. (Full Post Here: https://www.reddit.com/r/StardewValley/comments/dnpi6w/my_wife_lost_her_dog_pepper_on_friday_i_need_help/ ) The community pulled through and it happened!  Now everyone can bring that adorable lovable black poodle to their farm!

Thanks again to us/VladBacescu and u/7x7x7x7 for making this happen.
